item.title: Critical RCE Vulnerability in Apache HTTP Server
item.description:

item.title: Nvidia is preparing to oust Jensen Huang
United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers
item.description:
📝 United Airlines said on Wednesday that it is banning artificial intelligence agents from making flight reservations on behalf of travelers, citing security risks and the possibility that such actions could violate federal rules. "Flight searches cost airlines money, and undoubtedly United wants to avoid the expense associated with the surge of AI bot flight searches. United fares will continue to be bookable through flight aggregators such as Kayak, Hopper and Google Flights, Harteveldt said, adding that "consumers shouldn't find it any more difficult to find good fares on the airline.
🔗 Read more: https://www.cbsnews.com/news/united-airlines-bans-ai-agents-booking-flights/

item.title: Lean Grimoire
item.description:
📝 Back in July, I started experimenting with using modern coding agents to build a number of mathematical visualization applets. Just for fun, I also added an option to play in a “fantasy mode” in which various game elements are depicted using fantasy-themed flavor text (for instance, mathematical statements become “potions”, mathematical expressions become “scrolls”, and so forth).
